_comment: The rendezvous relay, on loopback so this example needs one machine. In a real deployment `bind` faces an edge that terminates TLS and routes <label>--tunnel.<zone> here, and the URLs are wss://. Nothing about the relay changes; it carries bytes either way.

relay._labels: Two keys per label, because two parties hold them: the park key lives on the device, the caller key is what you hand out. Real ones come from `openssl rand -hex 24`; these are fixed so the example is reproducible.
